messages:
alina: Kicking off a soft enable for slate-v2 tonight (EU cluster) at 23:00 UTC. Plan: 5% canary -> 20% after 30m -> full after 2h if no regressions. Need ops ack and any pin override notes.

matt: ack from eng. we've validated perf on dev and quant profiles look stable.

sarah: SRE ack, will watch tail latencies and 5xx for the first 45m. If P95 latency + errors spike > 2x baseline we'll trigger rollback.

jordan: quick question — are we changing fallback ordering for the route? currently slate->harbor->default.

alina: yes — for this rollout we want slate-v2 preferred, but keep fallback to harbor-13b then sentinel-quant. No change to TTLs.

matt: adding a temporary pin rule for support tier: pin support users to harbor if they hit >100ms extra p95. I can add rule to the catalog.

sarah: please include this in the release note blob so ops-bot can surface it.

deploy-bot: queued slate-v2 enable request by alina for eu-cluster at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Canary allocation: 5%. Preflight checks: model signature match ✅, quant profile loaded ✅, kv cache warmup script scheduled ✅.

alina: ops-bot, set rollback hook to error_rate>1.5% OR p95>2x for 30m continuous. Also enable automatic fallback to harbor in the same region.

ops-bot: rollback hook recorded: {"error_rate_threshold":"1.5%","p95_multiplier":"2.0","evaluation_window":"30m"}. Automatic fallback target: harbor-13b-eu. Alerts will page SRE after 3 consecutive evaluation windows.

matt: note — we'll keep a soft throttling cap: canary traffic limited to 400 rps. If we see queue growth > 20% I'll throttle to 2% and notify here.

sarah: deploying synthetic probes in 10m to exercise long-tail sequences. Sharing probe config: ```json
{"seq_lengths":[128,512],"prompt_types":["chat","completion"],"qps":10}
```

jordan: small ops ask — can we add a short-circuit pin for premium customers if we detect any hallucination regressions? i.e. immediate pin to last-stable.

alina: agreed. Add a manual pin path for premium; it requires two approvers (alina + matt). We'll include that in escalation steps.

matt: putting release note draft here: "soft enable slate-v2 (eu) — canary 5% -> 20% -> full. Fallback order: harbor-13b, sentinel-quant. Rollback triggers: 1.5% errors OR p95>2x for 30m. Premium customers have manual pin path (2 approvers)."

sarah: looks good. I'll be watching dashboards and will post a status check at +15m, +45m, +2h.

deploy-bot: scheduled: slate-v2 enable starts in 35m. Will post canary activation msg to this thread when live.

alina: thanks everyone. Please keep replies short during the window, call @sarah @matt if you need immediate rollback. :thumbsup:
